name: demoreel
description: Record a web app session, edit it like code, render a crisp README GIF. vhs for web apps.

scripts.build: esbuild src/replay-client.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/replay-client.js && esbuild src/cli.ts src/record.ts src/render.ts src/preview.ts src/suggest.ts src/replay-page.ts src/timeline.ts src/chrome.ts src/ffmpeg.ts --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist && tsc --noEmit
